💧 MPs have just told the government: do NOT hand Thames Water back to the people who broke it.

The EFRA Committee this week said ministers should reject the creditors' offer and prepare for special administration — or emergency legislation.

The numbers are grim:
🔴 16 million customers who have, in the committee chair's words, largely lost faith in the company
🔴 An opaque consortium of 100 hedge funds bidding to take it on
🔴 Over £900 MILLION in penalties expected over the next five years

And here's the kicker — the law as drafted apparently does not let ministers trigger special administration on performance grounds alone. They have to wait for the money to run out.

You cannot switch water supplier. The only discipline is the regulator. And the regulator has been too slow for twenty years.
